messages.text: Neville fears Carrick set to be sacked as Carra calls for decision tonight

metadata.summary: Michael Carrick looks poised to lose his job as Manchester United head coach following their 3-0 defeat at Old Trafford to Bournemouth, according to Gary Neville and Jamie Carragher.
metadata.content: Manchester United: Michael Carrick head coach on brink of losing job after Bournemouth defeat | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Manchester United: Michael Carrick head coach on brink of losing job after Bournemouth defeat Man Utd suffered a 3-0 loss to Bournemouth at Old Trafford on Sunday; Michael Carrick's future is in doubt after a eighth game without a win in all competitions Sunday 25 October 2026 17:29, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Speaking immediately after Manchester United's defeat to Bournemouth in the Premier League, Gary Neville gives his thoughts on Michael Carrick's future Michael Carrick looks poised to lose his job as Manchester United head coach following their 3-0 defeat at Old Trafford to Bournemouth, according to Gary Neville and Jamie Carragher. The humbling defeat leaves United just above the relegation zone following their worst-ever start to a Premier League season. "It is going to get ridiculously difficult for Michael Carrick to be Manchester United manager moving forward. That's the problem the club have got," said Neville during Sky Sports' match commentary. On his podcast, Neville concluded: "They are probably going to sack him." Carrick struck a defiant tone after the game but his lengthy applause towards the United fans after the final whistle was immediately interpreted as a farewell gesture. messages.text: Russia to host 2030 World Weightlifting Championships

metadata.summary: Moscow is set to host the 2030 World Weightlifting Championships, marking the first time a world championship for an Olympic sport will be held in Russia since the start of the Ukraine war.
metadata.content: Russia to host 2030 World Weightlifting Championships | Olympics News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Russia to host 2030 World Weightlifting Championships Russia has been awarded its first world championship in an Olympic sport since the start of the Ukraine war, with Moscow set to host the 2030 World Weightlifting Championships Sunday 25 October 2026 20:39, UK Image: Russia will host the 2030 World Weightlifting Championships Moscow is set to host the 2030 World Weightlifting Championships, marking the first time a world championship for an Olympic sport will be held in Russia since the start of the Ukraine war. The International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) confirmed the news on Sunday, four months after it announced Russian and Belarusian athletes would be eligible to compete in IWF events. messages.text: Drumbeat adds to O'Brien's two-year-old roll of honour

metadata.summary: Drumbeat added further depth to Aidan O'Brien's Classic battalion for next year in earning quotes of 14-1 for the Derby after landing the Criterium de Saint-Cloud at the Paris track.
metadata.content: Drumbeat wins Criterium de Saint-Cloud to add to Aidan O'Brien's two-year-old roll of honour | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Drumbeat wins Criterium de Saint-Cloud to add to Aidan O'Brien's two-year-old roll of honour It was a weekend to remember for Aidan O'Brien and the Ballydoyle team as Drumbeat delivered another Group One in the Criterium de Saint-Cloud and looks another colt with Classic potential in 2026 Sunday 25 October 2026 16:49, UK Image: Aidan O'Brien Drumbeat added further depth to Aidan O'Brien's Classic battalion for next year in earning quotes of 14-1 for the Derby after landing the Criterium de Saint-Cloud at the Paris track. The Wootton Bassett colt - wide-margin winner of the Zetland Stakes at Newmarket last time out - looked short of room at a crucial stage of the race under Ryan Moore, but burst through a gap to lead approaching a furlong and a half out. From there he stayed on too strongly for stablemate Shakespeare and Christophe Soumillon, the pair two lengths back in second with Joseph O'Brien's Jesus Green a further length away in third. The 9-10 favourite was delivering a seventh win in the race for O'Brien, but a first for Moore after wins for Soumillon aboard Pierre Bonnard 12 months ago and Los Angeles in 2023.
